title: The Lost Sprout
logline: When the youngest Knight follows a too-friendly stranger toward a secret door, the Knights race across the realm — and Sprout learns that calling for help is the bravest move of all.
lessons: A stranger offering a gift and asking you to keep it secret is the warning sign.
If a new friend wants to take you somewhere private — stop.
Being rushed is a red flag.
Sounding certain is not the same as being right — check before you act.
Calling for help is the brave move. You are never in trouble for asking.

productionNotes.method: Keyframes first, video second. Every shot boundary is a still generated from the character reference art; shot N ends on the same file shot N+1 starts on, so every cut lands on an identical image. The cross-cut threads (Knights / Sprout+Glitch) each resume on the exact frame they left.
productionNotes.budget: nano-banana-pro $0.15/still x 10 = $1.50. Seedance 2.5: 720p $0.473/s -> $14.19 per 30s shot -> $113.52 for 8 shots; 480p $0.2205/s -> $6.62 per shot -> $52.92 for 8. 1080p ($1.164/s) is out of reach. With $100 loaded: 480p fits the full 4 minutes with margin; 720p needs ~$20 more or a 7-shot (3.5 min) cut.
productionNotes.castRule: Character descriptions below are written from the actual reference art on the site (not the earlier movie-01 text, whose Sprout was wrong). They are prepended verbatim; only on-screen characters are described and sent as references for each still.
productionNotes.voiceRule: Seedance generates speech per clip, so voices can drift between shots. CANONICAL_VOICES describes each voice identically in every shot prompt to hold them steady.
productionNotes.textRule: No in-world text, ever — the earlier pilot garbled words. Captions/subtitles are added in post.

CAST.SIR SHIELDY: a small, kid-proportioned knight in bright golden armour: a shiny rounded gold helmet topped with a tall yellow feather plume, big warm brown eyes, a glowing yellow lightning-bolt crest on the gold chest plate, a golden cape, dark chainmail under-sleeves and gold boots. Calm, steady, kind leader.
CAST.PIXEL: an energetic boy with spiky messy brown hair, big brown eyes, rosy cheeks and a huge grin, wearing a teal-and-white hoodie with a game-controller pocket graphic, a teal backpack, olive-khaki jogger trousers and teal-and-white sneakers. Curious and quick.
CAST.GLITCH: a rounded egg-shaped purple blob creature with two big round eyes with blue-violet irises, thick purple eyebrows, a wide toothy grin, stubby purple arms, thin purple legs with flat feet, and small pink-and-purple pixel cubes floating around his body. A playful trickster — mischievous, never frightening.
CAST.BOT: a small white-and-silver robot with a smooth rounded head, a tiny antenna ball on top, a dark face visor showing two glowing cyan ring-shaped eyes, a round power-button emblem on the white chest, and thin jointed grey limbs with white armour plates. Speaks flatly and is confidently wrong.
CAST.SPROUT: a baby knight — a very small chubby toddler with rosy cheeks and big bright eyes, wearing a shiny gold helmet with a crest, tiny gold armour with a small shield emblem, a dark navy cape, navy mittens and navy boots, always holding a small brown teddy bear. Trusting and innocent.
CAST.DAME NOBLE: a girl knight in rose-gold copper armour with a heart crest on her chest plate, dark hair swept into a side ponytail with a small gold star hairpin, big brown eyes, a navy skirt, dark sparkly leggings, copper boots and a copper cape. Precise, kind — the one who checks things.

CANONICAL_WORLD: WORLD (unchanged in every shot): a bright, friendly digital realm built from glowing blue crystal towers, soft floating light-motes and smooth reflective floors — like a safe fantasy version of the inside of a computer. Pixar-style 3D animation with cinematic lighting, lens flares, volumetric god-rays and sparkling particle effects; warm and welcoming, colourful, absolutely nothing scary, no violence, no horror, no darkness beyond gentle dusk-blue.
CANONICAL_VOICES: VOICES (identical in every shot): SIR SHIELDY — warm, calm, steady adult male voice. PIXEL — bright, quick, excited boy's voice. GLITCH — squeaky, sly, playful cartoon-trickster voice. BOT — flat, even, slightly synthetic robot voice. SPROUT — tiny, sweet, very young child's voice. DAME NOBLE — clear, confident, kind girl's voice.
NO_TEXT_CLAUSE: CRITICAL: render NO letters, NO words, NO numbers, NO writing, NO signage, NO user-interface text, NO subtitles and NO logos anywhere in the frame. Any screen, popup or sign must show only abstract glowing shapes, colour and light — never characters or digits.

keyframes.frame: Wide establishing view of the crystal realm at soft dawn: tall glowing blue crystal towers rising around a wide open courtyard with a smooth reflective floor, warm golden dawn light coming from the left, floating light-motes drifting in the air. No characters.

Comfortable group shot in the courtyard centre, warm dawn light from the left. SIR SHIELDY stands centre with a calm smile; DAME NOBLE beside him polishing a small round shield; PIXEL bouncing on his toes with restless energy; BOT standing neatly at the side with his cyan eyes glowing; SPROUT sits cross-legged on the floor in front of them all, hugging the teddy bear and laughing. Everyone relaxed and safe.

Remove SPROUT completely (the small baby knight sitting on the floor) — leave an empty patch of reflective floor where they sat. Turn the four remaining heroes slightly toward EACH OTHER as if chatting: SIR SHIELDY and DAME NOBLE angled toward one another, PIXEL mid-gesture, BOT listening — none of them looking toward the right side of the frame. Keep all four exactly on-model, same sizes, same place on the left and centre of the frame; the right side of the frame stays open empty courtyard.

Add exactly two characters at the FAR RIGHT edge of the frame, small and partly cut off by the frame border, walking away to the right with their backs half-turned: SPROUT (toddling, teddy bear under one arm) following GLITCH, who glances back with a sly grin; a small glowing golden orb of light floats between them. The four heroes on the left stay exactly as they are, still talking to each other, unaware.

Same sunrise courtyard, warm dawn light from the left. The four heroes stand alert in a tight line, their bodies turned toward the RIGHT side of the frame and all looking that way: SIR SHIELDY at the front, his right arm fully extended POINTING TO THE RIGHT edge of the frame; DAME NOBLE just behind him holding Sprout's small brown teddy bear with a worried expression; PIXEL wide-eyed; BOT's cyan eyes bright. On the floor a faint trail of small glowing purple cubes leads from the group off to the right. Urgent but not frightened.

keyframes.locationNote: the same realm's crystal architecture style — but this frame is a different, quieter corner of it with cooler blue light and taller, narrower towers
keyframes.frame: A quiet narrow passage between tall crystal towers, cooler blue light, no dawn glow. GLITCH walks ahead to the right, glancing back over his shoulder with a wide coaxing grin; SPROUT toddles a few steps behind, teddy bear under one arm, gazing up at a glowing golden orb of light that floats between them.

keyframes.locationNote: the exact same narrow crystal passage and the same swirling violet spiral doorway on the right, same cool blue light — match the setting precisely; ignore the poses of the characters in it
keyframes.frame: SPROUT stands still on the left with both feet planted, no longer following, clutching the teddy bear and looking back over their shoulder uncertainly. A few steps ahead, GLITCH stands beside the swirling violet spiral doorway, one stubby arm beckoning toward it, wearing a HUGE forced toothy grin with eyebrows raised high and eyes wide and eager — friendly on the surface, trying too hard, NOT angry. The golden orb floats near the doorway.

keyframes.locationNote: the same realm and the same warm dawn light — this frame is a wide crystal avenue a little further along from the courtyard
keyframes.frame: A wide crystal avenue. The four heroes seen from a three-quarter side angle, bodies turned toward the RIGHT side of the frame, mid-stride, heading for a narrow gap between two tall crystal towers on the right: DAME NOBLE leading, her arm extended POINTING TO THE RIGHT at the gap; SIR SHIELDY beside her with a hand on BOT's shoulder; PIXEL right behind. A trail of small glowing purple cubes on the floor leads into the gap. Dawn light behind the group.

Same narrow crystal passage beside the swirling violet doorway, cool blue light. SPROUT stands firm with both little fists closed at their sides, chin up, teddy bear tucked under one arm, facing GLITCH bravely. GLITCH is hunched and no longer smiling, his colours a harder violet, reaching out a stubby arm. Between them the golden orb flickers, thin and dim — a hollow shell of light.

The same narrow crystal passage from the earlier frames: tall blue crystal walls, cool blue light now warming with gold from above, and the swirling violet spiral doorway of light set into the crystal wall at the RIGHT side. SPROUT is safe in the middle of the four heroes: DAME NOBLE kneeling with an arm around Sprout, PIXEL crouched close beside them, BOT standing just behind, SIR SHIELDY standing protectively in front of the group facing right with both arms spread wide. Harmless golden sparkles drift in the air to the right. Keep every character small and kid-proportioned exactly as in the references. The right edge of the frame is left empty.

Add exactly one GLITCH at the far RIGHT edge of the frame, standing on the floor: small, slumped and sheepish, shoulders drooping, looking down at the ground with a guilty frown — but keep his normal PURPLE colour and his pink-and-purple pixel cubes exactly as in his reference image (just a slightly duller purple, never white or grey). Nothing else in the frame changes.

The courtyard in full golden morning light. The heroes stand together in a warm hero line facing the camera: SIR SHIELDY in the centre with SPROUT sitting on his shoulders holding the teddy bear up high and beaming, DAME NOBLE and PIXEL on either side, BOT at the end, all smiling. A soft dome of warm golden light glows over the whole group.

shots.action: A sweeping aerial dive through the crystal realm as dawn breaks: the camera races between the glowing towers and each tower IGNITES with golden light as the sun touches it, light-motes swirl in the camera's wake and a flock of tiny glowing light-birds scatters upward. The camera plunges down into the courtyard and swings around the heroes in one smooth arc, revealing them one by one: SIR SHIELDY standing centre with a calm smile, DAME NOBLE polishing her small round shield so it flashes a glint of sun, PIXEL bouncing on his toes and spinning on the spot with restless energy, BOT turning in a neat circle with cyan scan-rings pulsing from his eyes, and SPROUT on the floor tossing the teddy bear up and catching it, giggling. An ordinary, happy, safe morning.

dialogue.line: Good morning, Knights. The realm is calm today.
Can we explore the far towers? Please?
After breakfast, Pixel. Sprout, stay close to us.
Okay!

shots.camera: Fast aerial dive between the towers, then a smooth descending arc around the group, settling on the comfortable group composition of the final frame.
shots.fx: Towers lighting up in sequence, lens flares, swirling light-motes, glowing light-birds, a glint off Dame Noble's shield, Bot's cyan scan rings.
shots.sound: Whoosh of the camera dive, bright crystalline chimes as each tower lights, light-birds fluttering, Sprout's giggle, calm morning ambience.

shots.lesson: A stranger offering a gift, and asking you to keep it secret, is the warning sign.
shots.action: The heroes drift into chatter among themselves, turned toward each other, distracted. Behind the nearest crystal pillar, GLITCH MATERIALISES from a shower of pink-and-purple pixel cubes that assemble into his body, peeks out with wide eyes, and tiptoes toward SPROUT with exaggerated comic sneaking steps. He throws both stubby arms up with a flourish and conjures a floating gift — a glowing golden orb that pulses hypnotically and sends out tiny golden fireflies that circle SPROUT's head. SPROUT reaches for them, delighted. GLITCH presses one arm to his mouth in a big 'shhh — our secret' gesture, glances at the busy grown-ups, and beckons toward the right. SPROUT looks at the beautiful orb, back at the grown-ups who are not watching, hesitates, picks up the teddy bear and toddles after GLITCH toward the right edge of frame, the orb floating between them and a faint trail of purple cubes left on the floor behind them.

dialogue.line: Psst. Hey. Want something special? Just for you.
For me? What is it?
A surprise! But don't tell the others. It's our secret.
Um... okay.

shots.camera: Static wide on the chatting heroes, then the camera slides low and right to follow Glitch's sneak, drifting with Sprout and Glitch toward the edge of frame for the final composition.
shots.fx: Glitch's pixel-cube materialisation, sparkle burst as the orb appears, hypnotic pulsing orb, golden fireflies circling Sprout, a faint purple cube trail on the floor.
shots.sound: Soft chatter, a crackly digital shimmer as Glitch assembles, squeaky tiptoe steps, a magical shimmer when the orb appears, a low hypnotic hum from the orb.

shots.lesson: The moment something feels wrong, tell someone straight away.
shots.action: Sprout and Glitch slip out of frame on the right. DAME NOBLE turns to say something to Sprout and freezes — a quick whip-pan to the empty patch of floor. She kneels and picks up the small teddy bear left behind, holding it up in close-up as her expression drops. PIXEL spins around, eyes wide. BOT steps forward and projects a cyan scanning grid across the whole floor; the grid sweeps and a trail of small purple cubes LIGHTS UP one after another, leading off to the right. SIR SHIELDY's helmet crest flares with golden light as his face sets — concerned, steady, never panicked — and he points firmly to the right, rallying the group into a tight line, bodies turned to the right, ready to run.

dialogue.line: Shieldy. Sprout is gone. The teddy is still here.
I didn't see anyone. I wasn't looking.
Trace detected. Purple particles. Heading east.
Then we go now. Nobody searches alone.

shots.camera: Whip-pan to the empty floor, push-in on Dame Noble and the teddy bear, pull back as Bot's grid sweeps, snap to the rallying line for the final frame.
shots.fx: Whip-pan, Bot's cyan scanning grid sweeping the floor, purple cube trail igniting cube by cube, Shieldy's crest flare, a soft golden pulse of light as he points.
shots.sound: A record-scratch-like stop as Dame Noble freezes, soft worried gasp, Bot's scanning beeps and a rising electronic hum, cubes chiming as they light, a determined whoosh on Shieldy's point.

shots.lesson: If a new friend wants to take you somewhere private, that is the moment to stop.
shots.action: GLITCH leads SPROUT deeper between the tall narrow towers, the golden orb floating ahead like a lantern; the crystal walls close in and the light cools to blue. GLITCH glances back repeatedly to check Sprout is still following. He stops at a crystal wall, spreads his arms, and a SWIRLING VIOLET PORTAL spins into existence from a crack in the crystal — a vortex of light that pulls loose light-motes spiralling into it. He bows and gestures grandly for SPROUT to step through first. The orb drifts toward the portal, tugging SPROUT's gaze. SPROUT looks at the portal, then back the long way they came, suddenly aware of how far from home they are. SPROUT's small shoulders tense; they stop walking and plant their feet. GLITCH's friendly smile stretches into a huge forced grin as he beckons harder.

dialogue.line: Almost there! Your surprise is just through here.
This is far away. I can't see my friends.
You don't need them. Come on, quickly, before it closes!
...Why do we have to be quick?

shots.camera: Tracking beside them through the narrowing passage, a dramatic low angle as the portal opens, then settling to the two-shot of the final frame as Sprout stops.
shots.fx: Lantern-like orb glow, the portal spinning open from a crack with a vortex of violet light, light-motes being drawn into the swirl, cool volumetric rays.
shots.sound: Footsteps echoing in crystal, a deep rising hum and a whoosh as the portal opens, wind being pulled toward the vortex, Glitch's wheedling tone.

shots.lesson: Sounding certain is not the same as being right. Check before you act.
shots.action: The heroes SPRINT out of the courtyard and along the wide crystal avenue following the glowing purple trail — the camera races alongside them. PIXEL vaults over a low crystal ledge, BOT glides fast on his feet, SIR SHIELDY's cape streams behind him, DAME NOBLE runs ahead scanning the floor. The trail SPLITS into two glowing paths. BOT skids to a stop, projects a cone of cyan scanning light down the left path, and states his conclusion with total flat confidence. The group starts to follow BOT — but DAME NOBLE stops, kneels, and touches the cubes on the right path: they PULSE brighter and warmer under her hand. She shakes her head, stands, and points firmly down the right path toward a narrow gap between two towers. BOT's eyes blink, recalculate, and he gives a small accepting nod. SIR SHIELDY puts a reassuring hand on BOT's shoulder. The group turns together and heads for the gap.

dialogue.line: Calculation complete. They went left. I am certain.
Wait. Let me check.
The sparks are warmer on the right. They went this way.
Correction accepted. I was sure. I was also wrong.
Being sure is easy, Bot. Checking is what keeps us right.

shots.camera: Fast tracking shot alongside the running group, a skid-stop at the fork, a low close-up on Dame Noble's hand and the pulsing cubes, then rising as they turn toward the gap for the final frame.
shots.fx: Speed streaks and light-motes whipping past, the trail splitting into two glowing paths, Bot's cyan scan cone, the warm cubes pulsing under Dame Noble's hand.
shots.sound: Rapid footsteps, whooshing wind, a skid, Bot's confident beeps, a warm pulsing tone as the cubes glow, a determined whoosh as they turn.

shots.lesson: Online, a person can look friendly and still not be a friend.
shots.action: SPROUT does not move. GLITCH's friendly act starts to CRACK: his colours flicker like a glitching screen, his welcoming smile stutters and flips into a frown, and his sweet coaxing gestures turn impatient and grabby as he lunges for SPROUT's hand. SPROUT pulls their hand back and takes a deliberate step backwards. As GLITCH's pretend friendliness falls away, the beautiful golden orb FLICKERS, thins to a hollow shell of light, and cracks like glass — revealing nothing inside. SPROUT stares at the empty orb, then at GLITCH, and understanding lands on their small face. SPROUT plants both feet, closes both little fists, lifts their chin — and the tiny shield emblem on their chest gives off a first small spark of golden light.

dialogue.line: Stop asking questions and take my hand!
You said you were my friend.
I said what you wanted to hear.
Then you were never my friend at all.

shots.camera: Slow push-in on Sprout as they hold their ground, a quick reverse on Glitch as the mask slips, then back to Sprout standing tall for the final frame.
shots.fx: Glitch's colours flickering like a broken screen with scattering pixel cubes, the orb cracking open as a hollow shell, a tiny golden spark on Sprout's chest emblem.
shots.sound: Digital static crackle as Glitch flickers, a glassy crack as the orb breaks, a soft brave chime as Sprout's emblem sparks.

shots.lesson: Calling for help is the brave move — you are never in trouble for asking.
shots.action: SPROUT takes a deep breath, turns toward the way they came, cups both mittened hands around their mouth and SHOUTS for their friends with everything they have. The shout bursts out as expanding golden rings of light — a shockwave that races away through the crystal passages, making every crystal it passes ring and glow — and the camera rushes along with the rings and back. GLITCH flinches and shrinks back from the light. The four heroes BURST into frame from the left at a run: PIXEL first, sliding in on his knees; SIR SHIELDY close behind with his cape flying; DAME NOBLE and BOT right after. DAME NOBLE drops to her knees and gathers SPROUT in, checking they are unharmed. SIR SHIELDY steps protectively between SPROUT and GLITCH, arms spread wide, and his lightning crest flares a dome of golden light — shielding without any violence. The hollow orb collapses into harmless golden sparkles. GLITCH deflates, shrinking small and sheepish at the right edge of frame.

dialogue.line: Shieldy! Help! I'm here!
Sprout! We've got you!
You're safe. You're safe now.
I'm sorry. I went with a stranger. I kept it a secret.
You called for us. That was the bravest thing you could do.

shots.camera: Wide as the shout rings out, a rush along with the shockwave and back, the heroes slide in from the left, then settling to the protective group composition of the final frame.
shots.fx: Golden shockwave rings from the shout, crystals ringing and glowing as the wave passes, speed streaks on the heroes' entrance, Shieldy's crest flaring a dome of light, the orb collapsing into sparkles.
shots.sound: Sprout's big shout with a long echo, bell-like crystal resonance rippling outward, running footsteps and a knee-slide, a triumphant whoosh as the shield light flares, a soft sparkle as the orb dissolves.

shots.lesson: Recap: secrets, gifts from strangers, being rushed, and going somewhere private are all signals to stop and tell someone.
shots.action: GLITCH sputters, gives a comic shrug, and POPS into a puff of pink and purple pixel-cube confetti that bounces harmlessly across the floor — defeated, never hurt. The light warms from cool blue to full gold as the group walks home through the crystal realm: SIR SHIELDY lifts SPROUT onto his shoulders, PIXEL bounds alongside, BOT walks steadily, DAME NOBLE hands SPROUT back the teddy bear. As they pass, each crystal tower lights up gold in turn like a wave of applause. They arrive in the sunlit courtyard, turn to face the camera and stand together in a hero line; their shields and crests light up in unison and a soft dome of warm golden light rises over all of them. SPROUT, on Shieldy's shoulders, holds the teddy bear up high and beams.

dialogue.line: How did you know he wasn't really my friend?
Real friends never ask you to keep secrets from the people who love you.
And they never rush you.
And they don't need you to go somewhere alone!
Then next time... I'll tell you first.
That's all we ask. Shield up, Knights.

shots.camera: Close on Glitch's pop, then a walking tracking shot home, rising into the warm hero wide shot of the final frame.
shots.fx: Glitch's confetti-cube pop, the light warming from blue to gold, towers lighting up in a golden wave as the heroes pass, shields glowing in unison, the golden dome rising over the group.
shots.sound: A comic pop and bouncing confetti cubes, a warm swelling tone as the towers light, happy footsteps, a bright chime on the final line.

AUDIO_RULE: AUDIO: clear lip-synced dialogue, vivid sound effects and ambience as described. NO background music and NO singing in this clip — the score is added afterwards.
